description: Update the main dashboard src/app/page.jsx to add privacyUrl and deleteUrl fields to all 14 app objects and restructure each card from a <Link> wrapper to an <article> with inner <Link> pills, avoiding nested anchor tags. Independent of FEAT-001 (the pages it links to may be built in either order).
steps: Read context.json first. Then read src/app/page.jsx in full to understand the current apps array and card JSX.

Add privacyUrl and deleteUrl fields to every app object in the apps array. Exact values: GEB TA Bill Pro (privacyUrl: '/privacy-policy', deleteUrl: '/geb_ta_bill/delete_account'), Gameliyo ('/gameliyo/privacy_policy', '/gameliyo/delete_account'), App Xray ('/appxray/privacy_policy', '/appxray/delete_account'), Arrow Escape ('/arrow_escape/privacy_policy', '/arrow_escape/delete_account'), Death Registry ('/death_registry/privacy_policy_url', '/death_registry/delete_account'), Funeral Poster ('/funeral_poster/privacy_policy_url', '/funeral_poster/delete_account'), Janazah ('/janazah/privacy_policy', '/janazah/delete_account'), Kutch News ('/kutch_news/privacy_policy', '/kutch_news/delete_account'), Maran Shrandhanjali ('/maran_shrandhanjali/privacy_policy_url', '/maran_shrandhanjali/delete_account'), Missing Person ('/missing_person/privacy_policy_url', '/missing_person/delete_account'), RSS Shakti ('/rss_shakti/privacy_policy', '/rss_shakti/delete_account'), Shrandhanjali Poster ('/shrandhanjali_poster/privacy_policy_url', '/shrandhanjali_poster/delete_account'), Sudoku ('/sudoku/privacy_policy', '/sudoku/delete_account'), Vishnu Puran Audio ('/vishnu-puran-audio/privacy-policy', '/vishnu-puran-audio/delete_account').

In the app grid JSX, replace the outer <Link key={app.href} href={app.href} className='group flex flex-col rounded-2xl border ...'> wrapper with <article key={app.href} className='flex flex-col rounded-2xl border ${app.border} bg-white p-5 shadow-sm'>. Remove 'group' class and 'hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md' from the article (card-level hover is replaced by per-link hover).

Inside the article, keep the icon+tag row and title+desc sections unchanged. Replace the bottom 'View app' div with:
View app 🔒 Privacy Policy🗑️ Delete Account
.
Remove the 'group-hover:text-slate-700' class from the h2 title element since there is no longer an outer group Link (just use 'text-slate-900').
acceptance_criteria: All 14 app objects in the apps array have privacyUrl and deleteUrl fields matching the specified URLs exactly
Each card is an <article> element, not a <Link>; there are no nested <a> tags
Each card shows three links at the bottom: 'View app →', '🔒 Privacy Policy' pill, '🗑️ Delete Account' pill
Privacy Policy pill links to the correct URL per app (e.g., /privacy-policy for GEB TA Bill, /gameliyo/privacy_policy for Gameliyo, etc.)
Delete Account pill links to /<appfolder>/delete_account for every app
`npm run build` completes with exit code 0
verification: Run `npm run build` from `d:\Google Ads Projects\GEB-TA-Bill-Pro-Dashboard` — expect exit code 0 with no JSX errors
Confirm the build output includes the root route '○ /' (dashboard) without errors
